title: After an Undo, a post the copy still holds is offered as an addition that brings it back
steps: Run the changeset case of a live post in the trash whose copy is published.
expect: The item writes the same live post out of the trash.
The item is in the add group, not the change group.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=after an Undo, a Tracy post the live site holds in the trash
tests: after an Undo, a Tracy post the live site holds in the trash is offered as an addition that brings it back (#117)
